evaluation.fitMonitorScope: 128 old and 128 new fit games by independent fixed hash; diagnostic only

limitations: Fresh holdout is original train, unseen by these 4096-game-fit models, not by historical full-train models.

Only public post-discard shanten and structurally improving unseen-tile count are added through 514 zero-initialized parameters. Initial logits and unclipped old-parameter gradients match; global clipping may change the first update because the new branch gradient is nonzero.
Same fixed small training budget; no full-corpus learning ceiling claim.
Mechanism screen, unchanged research quality screen and user per-model strict >75% target are separate.
Bootstrap intervals are pointwise exploratory; no simultaneous confidence or across-seed population claim.
Research-only scoring semantics, not loadable for App deployment without a separate reviewed implementation and acceptance.

resourceDecision.reason: One new MPS trainer at a time plus existing authorized four-player CPU validation; both structural preparations must be completed first. Same fit mapping plus 514 structure interaction parameters. Monitor actual memory pressure; no extra epochs or concurrent treatment arms.

sampling.normalization: mean of per-window full CE times fixed population importance coefficient; no batch self normalization

target: Every applicable true action class has choice-only complete-candidate Top1 strictly >0.75 in one model; no across-checkpoint combination.
